# Results { #ambdes.Results }

```python
Results(patients, run_number)
```

Simulation output for a single model run.

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [patient_df](#ambdes.Results.patient_df) | Return per-patient results as a DataFrame. |
| [summary_df](#ambdes.Results.summary_df) | Return a single-row summary DataFrame. |

### patient_df { #ambdes.Results.patient_df }

```python
Results.patient_df()
```

Return per-patient results as a DataFrame.

Each row represents one patient. Patients who had not completed
their full pathway by the end of the run will have NaN for unset
time attributes.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                                                                                |
|--------|--------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | Columns: run, patient_id, category, call_timestamp, response_time, travel_time_to_hospital, handover_time. |

### summary_df { #ambdes.Results.summary_df }

```python
Results.summary_df()
```

Return a single-row summary DataFrame.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type         | Description               |
|--------|--------------|---------------------------|
|        | pd.DataFrame | Columns: run, n_patients. |
